faq_heading: Homes near Crescent Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Crescent Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Crescent Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Crescent Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Crescent Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ocean Cliff Elementary (1.1 km south-west), Laronde Elementary (1.3 km south-east) and Elgin Park Secondary (1.4 km east).

Crescent Park Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 2440 128 St. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Late French Immersion.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Crescent Park Elementary.
How the Crescent Park Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Crescent Park Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Crescent Park Elementary

5 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Crescent Park Elementary in a straight line (4 elementary, 1 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Ocean Cliff Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Ray Shepherd Elementary, 2.3 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Elgin Park Secondary (1.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Ocean Cliff Elementary (1.1 km south-west), Laronde Elementary (1.3 km south-east), Chantrell Creek Elementary (1.8 km east), Ray Shepherd Elementary (2.3 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Ocean Cliff Elementary, 1.1 km south-west of Crescent Park Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Crescent Park Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Crescent Park Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Crescent Park Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at Ocean Cliff Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.1 km south-west of Crescent Park Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
